title: The Bid
logline: On an auction floor hands rise and fall in seconds, and a trader has to make up their mind before doubt catches up with them.
human_question: What does it take, in a moment of real money and real doubt, to actually make up your mind?

situation.what_happens: Lots come up fast and are sold in seconds each. A trader sees a lot, judges it, and either bids or does not, and there is no time to think it through; a hand that goes up late has already lost. Money changes hands on judgements made under open scrutiny, and the winners and losers of each lot are visible to everybody standing there. Afterwards traders talk about what they got and what they let go, which is the only place the hesitation gets described in words.
situation.who_is_involved: The traders, most of them regulars who know each other's habits; the auctioneer, whose pace sets everything; the producers whose goods are being sold and who may or may not be present; the carriers and small buyers whose day depends on the floor clearing quickly.
situation.what_is_at_stake: A margin on perishable goods that must be resold the same day, and in a bad hour, a real loss. For a producer, the whole worth of the work. For a trader who hesitates once too often, a standing that takes a long time to rebuild.
situation.how_it_unfolds: Trading like this starts when the goods arrive and is over fast because they spoil. The pressures are volume, quality, how many buyers turned up and how much cash each has. It ends with everything sold, with a lot unsold, or with a dispute, and nothing about which of those happens can be arranged.

concept_merge.why_together: C025 contributes the sources' rule that decision and doubt cannot occupy the same moment, together with the wider point their tables make, that effort, decisiveness, joy and the wish to act are ethically neutral and turn up in harmful and generous minds alike. C029 contributes what the machinery underneath carries: the bare moment of seeing has only the seven universals, receiving and investigating add landing on the object, staying with it and settling, determining adds effort for the first time, and none of them contains any wish to act at all. C009 contributes the bare rootless seeing itself, which carries no verdict about price or quality. An auction floor is where the line between all of that and the response that follows has money on it.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: The sources' table says the wanting only arrives after the machinery has finished. A trading floor shows what that looks like when it costs something: the lot is seen by everyone in the same bare way, and what separates the traders is entirely what happens after. It also keeps the film from a moral about greed, because the digest is explicit that drive and decisiveness are not virtues here and appear equally in harmful minds.

concept_links.why: The digest reports the source's reason for one of its exclusions directly: decision cannot coexist with doubt, so where one is present the other is not [C025-P:L69]. It also says the bare moments of seeing and hearing carry none of the six occasional factors, no effort, no wish, no decision. Two of the digest's limits are written in: energy, passion and decisiveness are not virtues in this framework and appear equally in harmful minds, so a film may not present drive as good in itself on the strength of this concept; and the counts, 55, 66, 78, 73, 51, 69, are a student's memorisation aid and must never appear as if they were measurements.

The digest reads the table as a small story: the bare moment of seeing carries only the seven basics; receiving and looking over add the capacity to land on the object, stay with it and settle on it; the step that fixes what the thing is adds effort for the first time; and not one of these steps contains any wish to do something, so the wanting only arrives after the machinery has finished [C029-P:L31-L55]. The digest's guard is carried: 'no wish-to-act in the early stages' is not 'we have no free will', and the factor counts are an analytical aid, not measurements of brain activity.

The digest describes the rootless sensing layer as weak, carrying no verdict of its own and, for sight and hearing, only neutral feeling [C009-P:L29-L60]. The moment a lot comes into view, before any judgement of price or quality, is that layer. The digest's guard that the source's treatment of pleasant and unpleasant contact as the result of past action must never become 'people get what they deserve' applies to everyone on the floor, winners and losers alike.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: These texts say that making up your mind and real doubt cannot occupy the same moment, and that the machinery of noticing that runs before it carries no wish to act at all. On a trading floor that line is visible, and it costs money.
what_must_be_real: Real lots, real money and real losses, with no bid staged or re-run. The livelihoods behind the goods may not be reduced to a setting for an idea about decisiveness, and no trader's bad hour may be edited into a character judgement.
position_hint: middle: its substance now sits inside the group's film about a fast public ruling, and it belongs wherever that film belongs.
risks: Portraying traders as greedy rather than as people managing real risk.
Reducing the economics behind the goods to a metaphor for a mental-factor lesson.
Presenting drive and decisiveness as virtues, which this concept's digest explicitly rules out.
Fast, crowded conditions carrying real safety and equipment risk.
drop_if: No auction allows real trading to be filmed.
Traders do not want their bidding and their losses shown.
The trading turns out to be too small or too irregular to sustain a film.

connections.note: Its doubt-into-decision strand and its C029 and C009 links, the neutral machinery that carries no wish to act, now sit inside IDEA-0083.
A fast public decision made under doubt leads into a harder decision made under real scarcity, with the stake on someone else.

selection.reason: Folded into IDEA-0083, which holds the group's slot on a fast public ruling and now carries C029 and C009 and the doubt-cannot-share-a-moment material with real stakes attached.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
